Australian jailed in Russia gives first prison interview

Australian Oscar Jenkins has given his first interview from a Russian prison following his sentencing. The interview marks the first time Jenkins has spoken publicly since being imprisoned in Russia. Specific details of his sentencing or the charges he faced were not provided in the coverage.
